basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old book enthusiast from Atlanta, Georgia. I recently graduated with a degree in Literature and have a knack for remembering obscure book details but not their titles! I love engaging in discussions about books and tech. When I'm not online, you can find me at a local coffee shop with a good novel or tinkering with my latest tech gadget. I work as a part-time barista while looking for a full-time job in publishing. I'm currently single and usually browse Reddit late at night after my shifts.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong foundation in literature, thanks to my college education where I specialized in contemporary fiction. Additionally, I have a growing interest in technology, which I am pursuing through online courses and self-study.
